browser_tool: Google Chrome logged-in as jkobject via Computer Use UI; Chrome extension node_repl bootstrap failed before browser control with sandboxCwd metadata error; actual successful downloads used visible Chrome SCP Download rows/Save dialogs.

datasets.notes: Public metadata lists raw and processed WTintegrated matrix families of identical 608,826,059-byte size plus separate genes/barcodes and metadata. Because raw vs processed representation choice is unclear and would require ~610 MB+ per matrix, no browser download was clicked blindly.

SCP page was visibly logged in as jkobject and exposed the 4-file Download table. Browser-auth file-row clicks recovered the two expression matrices and metadata with local/remote byte equality. HeartCluster.txt was visible but not staged because repeated post-download accessibility-ID instability jumped to SCP667; avoided further clicks to prevent unintended downloads.

Public metadata lists 31 files: one 253,356,316-byte combined expression+metadata pair plus multiple 10X mtx/gene/barcode groups from ~131 MB to ~4.9 GB. Representation choice is unclear, so no blind browser download was attempted.
Public SCP study metadata currently reports cell_count=0, gene_count=0, and study_files=[]; no expression or metadata file rows were available to recover.

Public metadata lists seven expression matrices (276-504 MB each) plus combined metadata and clusters. These are multiple sample/timepoint matrix families totaling roughly 2.7 GB before annotations; selection policy was unclear, so no blind multi-file browser download was attempted.

SCP499 page was visibly logged in as jkobject and exposed three intended files. Browser-auth file-row click recovered EB.matrix.txt.gz with byte equality. Small annotation files opened inline as signed Google Storage text rather than reliable Downloads files; a shell refetch of the browser-signed URL returned HTTP 400 and a subsequent UI path became unstable, so EB.idents.txt and EB.coordinates.txt were not staged.
